siteContent.cmsAboutSustainDesc:
Fabric-8 is
            committed to responsible sourcing and operational integrity. We work with manufacturers who maintain
            compliance with applicable labor standards, occupational health and safety requirements, and environmental
            regulations. Our quality control process includes pre-shipment inspection and documentation review to ensure
            every delivery meets agreed specifications. We are committed to continuous improvement in our environmental
            footprint and encourage clients to consider sustainable fabric options where applicable.
